newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms DuPont Canada debt, CP.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms DuPont Canada debt, CP.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday it confirmed the senior debt and commercial paper ratings of DuPont Canada Inc, at AA(low) and R-1(middle), respectively, with a stable rating trend.
DBRS said the DuPont's operating performance continues to be stable and above average.

The bond rating service said DuPont's diversity of products and the high degree of integration of its operations with the DuPont group should continue to maintain stability of its earnings going forward.
DuPont continues to accumulate cash as it is still searching for a suitable long-term investment opportunity, DBRS said. It said the balance sheet remains extremely strong.
DuPont's only interest-bearing debt matures on December 19, 1996, after which the company will have no public debt outstanding, DBRS said.
